notes: Governmental funds modified cash basis; business-type accrual (as in FY2023-FY2025). Governmental lines from the Statement of Cash Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (p5, Total Governmental Funds): fund balance 965,441 + 1,626,906 - 1,862,314 + transfers in 916,307 - transfers out 508,335 = 1,138,005. No cash roll-forward printed, so beginning_cash is null; ending_cash/ending_investments are the printed Total Governmental Funds 'Cash and cash equivalents' 870,718 and 'Certificates of deposit' 15,000 (p4); county treasurer cash 13,921 and restricted cash in bank 238,366 are not included. Business-type from the Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds (p7, Total): 7,754,124 + prior period adjustment 133,921 = 7,888,045 + 3,296,326 - 3,002,717 - 407,972 = 7,773,682; disbursement total from the Statement of Activities (p2, total business-type expenses 3,002,717). proprietary left null as in the later years (report basis is modified cash; proprietary cash flows p8: operating 678,422, noncapital (407,972), capital and related (434,720), investing 24,281, cash 3,089,903 -> 2,949,914). Balance sheet: governmental lines from p4 (totals equal the government-wide 1,138,005, p1), business-type from p1. Detail: General Fund from the combining schedules (revenue and capital outlay by sub-fund column pp14-15; expenditure objects by sub-fund column pp16-17; transfers from the Total column p15, sub-fund transfers 1,113,675 eliminated); General Fund Taxes 735,189 split into Property taxes 431,970 and Sales taxes 303,219 (p9 budget schedule / p5 General column). The General Fund budget schedules (pp9-10) are less detailed and not recorded. Functions follow p5: General column = general government; Police and Fire = public safety (395,700); Parks, Swimming Pool and Library = culture and recreation (276,450). Streets from its budget schedule (p12 revenue, capital outlay and debt; p13 expenditure objects; Taxes 106,625 split into Property 41,193 and Sales taxes 65,432 from the p5 Streets column; parent final budget 80,500). Keno from its budget schedule (p18). The trimmed PDF has no budget schedules for the proprietary funds, so Electric, Water, Sewer, Community Center and Nursing Home detail comes from their columns on the proprietary statement (p7) and Landfill and Gas/Pace from the non-major combining schedule (p19); operating totals are the detail totals, so interest income/expense lines carry outside_printed_total.
